wp_items.title: Drug Addiction: Symptoms & Signs
wp_items.yoast_title: Drug Addiction: Symptoms & Signs - Addiction Rehab Centers

blocks.text: The cold, hard truth about drug addiction is that if you think you have a drug problem, it’s very likely that you do. Drug addiction symptoms vary from addict to addict, and no two addicts develop drug addiction signs that look exactly alike. Knowing the symptoms of drug addiction, though, can inspire you to get clean before your drug problem completely overtakes your life.

blocks.text: Drug Addiction Symptoms: How Drugs Affect Your Health
blocks.html: Drug Addiction Symptoms: How Drugs Affect Your Health

blocks.text: Many drug addicts are surprised to see just how quickly their drug problem undermines their physical or mental health. If you have several of these drug addiction signs, you’re almost certainly an addict:
blocks.html: Many drug addicts are surprised to see just how quickly their drug problem undermines their physical or mental health. If you have several of these drug addiction signs, you’re almost certainly an addict:

items.text: You have new or worsening physical or mental health problems since you began using.
items.html: You have new or worsening physical or mental health problems since you began using.

items.text: You use drugs because prescription medications are ineffective at treating your symptoms.
items.html: You use drugs because prescription medications are ineffective at treating your symptoms.

items.text: You use a higher dose of prescription drugs than prescribed by your doctor, or you engage in doctor-shopping to get access to more prescription drugs.
items.html: You use a higher dose of prescription drugs than prescribed by your doctor, or you engage in doctor-shopping to get access to more prescription drugs.

items.text: You feel depressed, anxious, or overwhelmed when you try to quit using.
items.html: You feel depressed, anxious, or overwhelmed when you try to quit using.

items.text: You use drugs to cope with the physical or psychological effects of a chronic health condition.
items.html: You use drugs to cope with the physical or psychological effects of a chronic health condition.

items.text: You suffer from physiological or emotional withdrawal symptoms when you attempt to stop using.
items.html: You suffer from physiological or emotional withdrawal symptoms when you attempt to stop using.

items.text: You struggle with chronic pain.
items.html: You struggle with chronic pain.

items.text: You’re losing or gaining weight at a rapid rate.
items.html: You’re losing or gaining weight at a rapid rate.

items.text: Your sleeping habits have changed; you either sleep too much or not enough, and you may experience nightmares or panic attacks in the middle of the night.

items.text: Your eating habits have changed; some drug addicts suffer from obesity or malnutrition due to drug-induced changes in food consumption.

items.text: You experience a rapid heart rate.
items.html: You experience a rapid heart rate.

items.text: You have chronic medical conditions, such as diabetes or fibromyalgia, that didn’t exist prior to the addiction.

blocks.text: Drug Addiction Signs: How Drugs Affect Your Relationships
blocks.html: Drug Addiction Signs: How Drugs Affect Your Relationships

blocks.text: For many people with a drug problem, the first drug addiction symptoms come in the form of changed relationships. Many addicts end up losing their marriages or long-term relationships; others find themselves embroiled in near-constant conflict with children, spouses, or parents. Some common ways drugs affect relationships include:

items.text: Believing that your loved ones are to blame for the problems in your life.

items.text: Demands from loved ones that you seek treatment or get sober.
